name: Pardot
description: Salesforce Account Engagement, formerly Pardot, is a B2B marketing automation platform for prospects, campaigns, scoring, forms, email, and sales alignment. Organizations use it to manage marketing journeys and connect engagement activity with Salesforce CRM.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Account Engagement business unit with a customer-owned Salesforce external client app and encrypted OAuth refresh credentials limited to pardot_api and offline refresh access. Relay exposes only the selected prospect's ID and timestamps plus bounded metadata for one selected campaign; contact data, scores, activities, other assets, bulk access, exports, and mutations are blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_ENVIRONMENT
credentialRequirements.label: Account Engagement environment
credentialRequirements.helpText: Exactly production, sandbox, or developer; Relay pins the matching Salesforce token and Account Engagement API origins.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Salesforce external client app ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: A customer-owned external client app configured only for Account Engagement API and offline refresh access.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Salesforce external client app secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts this customer secret and sends it only to the selected Salesforce token origin.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_REFRESH_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Salesforce OAuth refresh token
credentialRequirements.helpText: A refresh token issued to an SSO-enabled Account Engagement user for the customer-owned app.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Account Engagement business unit ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact 18-character 0Uv business unit ID sent on every API request.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_PROSPECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected prospect ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one prospect whose ID and timestamps Relay may read.

credentialRequirements.name: PARDOT_CAMPAIGN_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected campaign ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The one campaign whose bounded summary Relay may read.

capabilities.label: Read selected prospect summary
capabilities.description: Read only the ID and timestamps for one selected prospect without contact, activity, score, assignment, or custom fields.

capabilities.label: Read selected campaign summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded organizational metadata for one selected campaign.

allowed.label: Read selected prospect summary
allowed.description: Read the selected prospect's ID and timestamps while discarding all personal and marketing fields.

allowed.label: Read selected campaign summary
allowed.description: Read the selected campaign's ID, name, deletion state, and timestamps while discarding cost, folder, user, CRM, and related fields.

blocked.label: Expose private marketing data
blocked.description: Prospect contact, preference, score, activity, custom, assignment, and CRM fields plus campaign cost, folders, users, raw responses, and tokens are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate Account Engagement state
blocked.description: Prospect changes, campaigns, tags, sends, assets, imports, exports, administration, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Account Engagement access
blocked.description: Other environments, business units, prospects, campaigns, objects, lists, searches, pages, versions, bulk APIs, arbitrary paths, redirects, downloads, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Read Only
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected prospect and campaign through a business-unit-bound customer OAuth grant; private data, broader access, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway refreshes encrypted customer-owned Salesforce OAuth credentials server-side and mounts exactly two business-unit-bound projected reads.
Railway refreshes encrypted customer-owned Salesforce OAuth credentials server-side and mounts exactly two business-unit-bound projected reads.

providerSetup.blocker: A Salesforce organization with Account Engagement, an SSO-enabled user, customer-owned external client app, OAuth refresh grant, exact business unit, environment, and staging object IDs are required. No authorized account or credentials are available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Salesforce administrator must create a customer-owned external client app with only Manage Pardot services and offline refresh access, grant it to an SSO-enabled staging user, capture the refresh grant in the provider-console lane, connect the exact business unit/environment/object IDs, then validate both projections, wrong-unit and wrong-host denial, refresh, revocation, replacement, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Salesforce documents Salesforce OAuth with pardot_api, SSO-enabled users, exact 18-character 0Uv business unit IDs, bearer and business-unit headers, and production, sandbox, and developer domains.

Salesforce documents customer external client apps, Manage Pardot services scope, optional refresh scope, exact callback requirements, sensitive client credentials, and environment-specific API hosts.
Salesforce documents Version 5 selected-object GET paths, required explicit fields, supported HTTP verbs, response caching, and bounded query conventions.
Salesforce documents selected Prospect reads, explicit fields, view abilities, and the sensitive prospect field set excluded by Relay.
Salesforce documents selected Campaign reads, required view ability, and campaign fields used for the bounded projection.
Salesforce documents invalid OAuth, missing business-unit headers, wrong environment hosts, object-not-found responses, timeouts, and rate limits.
